title: HackCHARUSAT 2026
description: 36-hour flagship hackathon bringing together bright student coders to solve real-world problems using AI, IoT, and Web3.

title: CodeStorm Competitive Coding
description: 3-round algorithmic challenge testing Data Structures and Algorithms with speed and efficiency scoring in C++, Java, and Python.

title: Spoural Annual Cultural Fest
description: The mega youth festival of CHARUSAT featuring music bands, solo/group dances, theatrical plays, and star celebrity night.

title: Full Stack Web Dev Bootcamp
description: Intensive hands-on practical workshop covering modern responsive UI, procedural PHP backends, MySQL, and Fetch API CRUD.

title: Inter-Department Cricket Cup
description: Exciting T20 league tournament contested between CE, IT, CSE, and BCA departments for the rolling championship trophy.

title: AI & Deep Learning Masterclass
description: Expert session by senior researchers on neural networks, large language model prompt engineering, and career roadmaps.

title: RoboWars Combat Championship
description: Thrilling combat robot showdown with custom-built 15kg and 30kg remote-controlled fighting bots inside an armored cage.

title: Rangoli & Canvas Art Exhibition
description: Fine arts celebration showcasing creative rangoli, water-color painting, pencil sketching, and digital graphic posters.

title: Badminton Singles & Doubles League
description: Fast-paced tournament for badminton enthusiasts across all university years with synthetic courts and referee panel.

title: Cyber Security & Bug Bounty Session
description: Learn OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities, ethical penetration testing techniques, and responsible disclosure platforms.

title: Kavyanjali Poetry & Open Mic
description: An evening of spoken word poetry, acoustic musical performances, and storytelling under the starry campus sky.

title: AppDev Android & Flutter Jam
description: Build cross-platform mobile applications from scratch, connect them to REST backends, and publish APK packages.

title: Inter-College Table Tennis Challenge
description: Table tennis championship featuring intense spin rallies, singles knockout brackets, and university team selections.

title: UI/UX Design Sprint
description: Rapid 6-hour wireframing and prototyping challenge in Figma creating mobile apps for rural Indian farmers and students.

title: Alumni Networking & Mentorship Meet
description: Connect with distinguished CHARUSAT alumni working in top tech companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, TCS, and Infosys.
